about: The ONE constants file (Blueprint invariant 14; A26's shared shape, R32). Each set is closed: every value carries its own code, and each names its authority and why it is closed (FEATURE_PIPELINE section 5 item 14). The API reads this file through functions/src/config/closedSets.js; the app reads app/lib/core/config/closed_sets.dart, generated from it by `npm run gen:closed-sets` (a tools test fails while that file is stale). Wording for each value lives in ARB, keyed by value; the values themselves are codes, never shown.

PublishProblemKind.authority: spec/P0-03.md r2 section 3.2 (AC-11 to AC-20) and EC-36; plan/FF-3-publish-engine.md 1.0 section 3. One kind per refusal: UNREVIEWED AC-11; WALL_CROSSING AC-12; UNREACHABLE AC-13 and AC-40; ORPHAN AC-14; CONNECTOR_UNPAIRED AC-15(a); LIFT_STOPS AC-15(b); CONNECTOR_OFF_WALKWAY AC-15(c); CONNECTOR_NO_RISE AC-15(d); OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY AC-16; BEACON_DUPLICATE and BEACON_NAMESPACE AC-17; SHAPE_UNREADABLE AC-18; TENANT_MISMATCH AC-19; NOTHING_TO_PUBLISH AC-20.
PublishProblemKind.whyClosed: Each kind is a check the publish engine runs in code; a new kind needs new code and its ARB wording.

PublishWarningKind.authority: spec/P0-03.md r2 AC-22 (NO_BEACONS_ON_LEVEL, ruled D8), AC-23 (DOOR_WIDTH_UNMEASURED) and AC-75 (GRAPH_LARGE, PACKAGE_LARGE; ruled D14); EC-6: these and no others.
PublishWarningKind.whyClosed: Each kind is a check the publish engine or the publish service runs in code; a warning never refuses a publish.

GraphEdgeKind.authority: spec/P0-03.md r2 AC-42 (walk, connector or store crossing); spec/P0-06.md r2 section 3 item 1.
GraphEdgeKind.whyClosed: Each kind is a way the router treats an edge in code: a walkway, a floor change, or a crossing through a walk-through store (L92).

ConnectorCostModel.authority: db/schema.sql 0.14 CK_ConnectorType_CostModel; Blueprint section 3.2. The publish engine reads it for the lift and two-ended connector rules (spec/P0-03.md r2 AC-15, AC-33; ruled D7).
ConnectorCostModel.whyClosed: Each value is a connector behaviour in code (how its ends and rise are read, step-free, evacuation); connector TYPES are the ConnectorType lookup.

NavCorrectionKind.authority: db/schema.sql 0.14 CK_NavCorrection_Kind; L32; spec/P0-03.md r2 DC-6 and AC-27.
NavCorrectionKind.whyClosed: Each kind is a graph-generation operation in code.

ShapeKind.authority: db/schema.sql 0.14 CK_Unit_Shape and CK_FloorObject_Shape; L39. The publish engine reads it to draw a box floor object stored without GeoJSON (spec/P0-03.md r2 AC-18, AC-24).
ShapeKind.whyClosed: Each kind is geometry code: a box from its centre, size and rotation, or a drawn polygon.
